---
name: pr-summary
description: Summarize a pull request for reviewers when the user asks for a PR description, review summary or change overview.
---

# Pull request summary

1. Read the diff and the linked issue.
2. Group the changes by component and name the user-visible behavior each
   group changes.
3. List the tests that cover the change, and call out any that are missing.

Follow references/format.md for the section order reviewers expect.
